messages:
Incident Bot: paging raghav (oncall) — MontaraBank (enterprise VPC) reports reduced observability for tenant montara-prod, traces missing and logs delayed. severity: sev2 :rotating_light:
Raghav (oncall): picking this up. what systems are affected? any customer-facing errors?
Seana (sre): montara-prod request traces disappear after 1.5s of trace time; spans for model-serving containers not present in their trace view. metrics show p95 latency spike. logs are present in main silo but Montara's tenant-forwarder role is throwing 403s when calling the central forwarder API.
Emily (acct): Montara engineering just DM'd asking if we can access their traces for a postmortem. they're on a support call now.
Raghav (oncall): ok. initial hypothesis: VPC-forwarder role token rotated incorrectly during a maintenance push, resulting in per-tenant forwarder failing to write to our central obsv ingestion. will attempt to validate.
Carla (eng): I can check the forwarder pod logs in the montara namespace. running: ```kubectl -n montara logs deploy/tenant-forwarder -c forwarder --since=30m```
Ben (infra): I see repeated 403s in the IAM proxy logs: `403 AccessDenied: role session expired`. ticket INF-2893 shows a role rotation window at 2026-03-15T02:10Z.
Montara infra team: confirming — we rotated some keys as part of scheduled rotation. didn't expect it to affect traces, only metrics. sorry.
Raghav (oncall): thanks. immediate mitigation: reissue a temporary role binding to allow forwarder to push traces while we do a proper key rotation rollback. Ben, can you run the emergency binding?
Ben (infra): creating a temporary policy now. command: ```gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding redwood-forwarder@proj --member=serviceAccount:montara-forwarder@proj --role=roles/logging.writer --condition=None``` applying it with `--no-dry-run`. will monitor.
DevOps Bot: policy change detected by infra pipeline — change ID chg-7521 applied by Ben.
Raghav (oncall): after policy apply, please tail the forwarder logs and verify 200s. Caria / Carla, re-check trace ingestion.
Carla (eng): seeing 200s now and traces reappearing for new requests. older spans still missing. looks like a gap window from 02:07–02:20Z.
Seana (sre): metrics ingest resumed, but we still have a per-tenant partitioning issue — Montara's trace index shards didn't get rehydrated from the buffer store during the outage. reingestion job will be required.
Raghav (oncall): create a replay job for that tenant for the gap window. instructions: run the tenant-replay job with target tenant id and time range. example: ```./tools/replay --tenant montara-prod --start 2026-03-15T02:07:00Z --end 2026-03-15T02:20:00Z --type traces```
Ben (infra): launched replay job: replay-215555-r1. CLI output: `queued -> running`. I'll watch for errors.
Montara infra team: appreciate quick response. Montara wants an ETA for full trace restoration and a note to their compliance team.
Raghav (oncall): ETA: replay typically 20–40 minutes depending on volume. I'll keep customer comms via Emily. Emily, can you draft a short note to Montara with timeline and apology?
Emily (acct): drafting: "We've identified a role rotation impact affecting trace forwarding for montara-prod between 02:07–02:20Z. We've applied a temporary policy, traces are streaming again, and we're replaying missing data. ETA for replay completion ~30 minutes. We'll follow up with a detailed root cause and long-term fix." any additions?
Carla (eng): include note that logs were never lost in primary silo; only forwarding to their tenant view was impacted. that helps compliance.
Seana (sre): post-mortem action items: 1) ensure role rotations are validated against forwarder token refresh 2) add automated test to simulate rotation during low-traffic windows 3) add alert for per-tenant ingestion gap (threshold: >1m of missing spans)
Raghav (oncall): adding runbook step: if forwarder 403s on role rotation, temporarily bind legacy role and escalate to infra for key-rollback window. document in runbook.
PagerDuty Bot: Raghav (oncall) acknowledged pager duty incident 2155554321.
Ben (infra): replay job completed: `replay-215555-r1` finished successfully, rehydrated ~12k spans. post-replay check shows trace coverage restored for gap window.
Carla (eng): verified with montara-prod trace samples — spans present and causal graphs intact.
Montara infra team: confirmed receiving traces and logs. thanks.
Raghav (oncall): incident status: mitigated (customer-facing observability restored). moving to retrospective. tagging owners for follow-up: Ben for policy automation, Seana for alerting, Carla for runbook updates.
Emily (acct): sending customer note now and scheduling a post-incident call with Montara for 2026-03-16 15:00Z.
Seana (sre): quick notes for postmortem: timeline, role rotation window, buffer reingestion gap, mitigation steps, and action items. I'll open INC-215555-PM and assign.
Incident Bot: incident closed by Raghav (oncall) — severity downgraded to sev3 after confirmation of replay. :white_check_mark:
Raghav (oncall): thanks team. lessons learned: double-validate rotation playbooks for per-tenant forwarders, and add a synthetic trace probe per tenant to detect gaps sooner.
